## FAQs


What do I need to set up?


Getting started is easy with the Ooma Setup app. Just connect your base station to Wi-Fi, plug in your phone, and start calling in 15 minutes or less.


Who can my child call and receive calls from?


Your child can only communicate with approved contacts you input in their Trusted Circle, ensuring they stay connected to only the family and friends you trust.


Can I control when my child can use the phone?


Yes. With Quiet Hours, you can block all incoming and outgoing calls during specific times, making it ideal for scheduling around school, homework, or bedtime.


Does MyPhone support emergency calling?


Absolutely. The service includes address-based 911, so emergency responders receive your child’s location. You’ll also get text and email alerts if 911 is contacted.


You must provide and keep updated your MyPhone location for accurate 911 calling. See[E911 Terms and Disclosures | Ooma](https://www.ooma.com/legal/e-911-terms-and-disclosures/) for more details.


Can my child make group calls with friends?


Yes! The Party Line feature allows your child to have 3-way calls with friends, making it easy to stay social in a safe, controlled environment.


Can family members leave messages?


Of course. Loved ones can leave voicemails, so your child can hear messages from grandparents, parents, and friends anytime.


Can I monitor my child’s phone activity?


Yes. Parents have access to an online call log, so you can review call history and stay informed about your child’s communication.


Does the service work outside my immediate area?


MyPhone provides stress-free calling across North America.


Is this a full phone service or just an app?


It’s a full-featured phone service, not just an app—built from the ground up with safety, simplicity, and parental control in mind.


How does MyPhone help keep my child safe?


By combining restricted contacts, scheduled usage, emergency support, and activity monitoring, MyPhone Kids creates a safe communication environment tailored for children.


Can I connect the Base Station using Wi‑Fi or a wired connection?


The Base Station can connect over Wi‑Fi or be hardwired directly to your router with an Ethernet cable, giving you flexibility to choose the setup that works best for your home.
